**1 — Scene:** A light cooked breakfast: fried egg, grilled tomato halves and mushrooms, with Greek-style yogurt and a milky coffee.

**2 — Vessel:** The main plate appears to be about **23 cm** across. Area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**. The yogurt pot and mug are estimated separately.

**3 — Items:** One egg, two tomato halves, three mushrooms, a light cooking-oil sheen, Greek-style yogurt, and coffee with milk/foam. No sugar or additional sauce is assumed.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Gross volume calculation | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Grilled tomatoes | 27% | 112 cm² × 1.5 cm = 168 ml | 0.65 | 109 g | 20 | 22 kcal |
| Fried egg, excluding oil | 17% | 71 cm² × 0.75 cm = 53 ml | 0.95 | 50 g | 155 | 78 kcal |
| Cooked mushrooms | 13% | 54 cm² × 1.8 cm = 97 ml | 0.60 | 58 g | 28 | 16 kcal |
| Cooking oil | Overlaps food | Thin visible sheen; approximately 3.3 ml | 0.91 | 3 g | 884 | 27 kcal |
| Greek-style yogurt | Separate pot | Approximately 100 ml | 1.0 | 100 g | 120 | 120 kcal |
| Milky coffee | Separate mug | Approximately 200 ml, including foam | 0.90 | 180 g | 35 | 63 kcal |

The plated foods cover approximately **57%** of the plate; oil overlaps those areas rather than adding coverage. The sealed yogurt's contents cannot be seen, so its weight assumes this is a small, approximately 100 g pot.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **220 g and 143 kcal on the plate**, or **500 g and 326 kcal including yogurt and coffee**, is plausible for this modest breakfast. The largest uncertainties are the yogurt’s fat content, milk quantity and cooking oil.
